$description: Motion tokens — durations and easing curves consumed by Truss at build time. Unlike colors, motion is not themed at runtime, so values flow into truss-motion.ts as JS literals (no CSS variables).

fast.$description: Quick UI feedback — small property changes, tooltip fades.

normal.$description: Default Beam transition duration. Used by Css.transition and the per-property motion helpers.

slow.$description: Larger spatial changes — drawer slides, layout reflows.

standard.$description: Symmetric ease-in-out for elements that change shape (open ↔ close).

decelerate.$description: Ease-out for entering elements (decelerating into final position).
